**Break:** chaos fault `unavailable`: every /v1/* call returns 503  
**Expected:** retries, circuit breaker opens, UI served from cached state, degraded banner; automatic recovery

|---|---|
| fault injected | HTTP 200 at tick 610 |
| PASS circuit breaker opened | after 5.8 s: read breaker OPEN, write breaker CLOSED; last error FAULT_INJECTED |

| PASS recovered after the fault expired | after 20.8 s more: read breaker CLOSED, write breaker CLOSED |
